examples.text: Su madre sintió vergüenza por él.
examples.en: His mother was ashamed of him.

examples.text: No tengas vergüenza de ser pobre.
examples.en: Don't be ashamed of being poor.

examples.text: A él le da vergüenza preguntar.
examples.en: He is ashamed to ask questions.

examples.text: Trajo la vergüenza a su familia.
examples.en: He has brought shame upon his family.
